position: Research-layer rule calibration —— **不修改** v0.1 / Robustness / Feasibility / Driver Canonicalization。

A_theme_precedence_bug.symptom: OFFSHORE-WIND × C-2020-POWER-NE 带主题判 THEME_ONLY、去主题判 STRUCTURAL_PARTIAL
A_theme_precedence_bug.cause: v0.1 规则中 `elif same_theme: THEME_ONLY` 先于 `elif driver ∈ GOOD: STRUCTURAL_PARTIAL`
A_theme_precedence_bug.fix: 结构性判定置于主题判定之前；Theme 仅用于 THEME_ONLY 的**事后**派生

B_event_low_selectivity.fix: overlap == 1 不再算 PARTIAL（→ MISMATCH）；PARTIAL 需 ≥2 类型真实对应

C_driver_partial_too_broad.fix: 引入 primary_mechanism；overlap == 1 且非历史 primary → PERIPHERAL_OVERLAP（不计为支持）

1_theme_structural_decoupling.rule: Structural Status 只由四维决定；Theme Relation 为独立 metadata；THEME_ONLY 事后派生

2_event_rule.MATCH: 类型集合相等 且 双方 ≥2 事件 且 首项相同（TYPE_AND_CHRONOLOGY）
2_event_rule.PARTIAL: 类型交集 ≥2 且 双方 ≥2 事件（MULTI_TYPE_WITH_CHRONOLOGY）；或交集 ≥2 但 chronology 不完整
2_event_rule.anti_pattern: 不得因「都有 policy event」就 MATCH；Event 不能证明 Driver

3_driver_rule.primary_mechanism: 历史侧：DIRECT 计数最高（确定性 tie-break：canonical 名称升序）；无 DIRECT → UNKNOWN（不猜）
3_driver_rule.MATCH: 集合相等 且 ≥2 项 且 历史侧对共有机制有 DIRECT provenance
3_driver_rule.PARTIAL: 交集 ≥2（MULTI_MECHANISM）；或 交集 ==1 且该机制为历史 primary（PRIMARY_MECHANISM_OVERLAP）
3_driver_rule.PERIPHERAL_OVERLAP: 交集 ==1 且非历史 primary → **不计为结构支持**

conditions: Evidence Sequence ∈ {MATCH, PARTIAL} 且 subtype ∈ {SEQUENCE_MATCH, SEQUENCE_PARTIAL}
≥2 个非 Lifecycle 维度有 evidence-backed support

calibration.5_structural_partial: ≥2 维度真实对应 且 Driver ∈ GOOD 且 Evidence Sequence ∈ GOOD
calibration.6_theme_only: **结构评估之后**派生：结构支持不足 且 Theme Relation = SAME_MACRO_THEME
